name: Waldorf micro Q
description: Waldorf micro Q (Omega, lite and keyboard) synthesizer: every sound parameter of its manual's controller chart, as control changes.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/waldorf/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/waldorf/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the manual's controller chart, with its printed name, sent as a control change on the channel variable. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
The Glide Mode (CC 51) and the filter types (CC 68, 79) are numbers here: the manual lists their values in its chapters, not beside the chart.

Left out, controllers the manual prints `- not used -`: CC 0 Bank Select MSB, CC 3 undefined, CC 6 Data Entry, CC 8 Balance, CC 9 undefined, CC 11 Expression, CC 62 undefined, CC 63 undefined, CC 119 undefined, CC 124 Omni Mode Off, CC 125 Omni Mode On, CC 126 Poly Mode On/Off, CC 127 Poly Mode On.

Left out, controllers the manual marks `*`, which change no setting of the sound: CC 1 Modulation Wheel*, CC 2 Breath Control*, CC 4 Foot Control*, CC 7 Channel Volume*, CC 10 Pan*, CC 32 Bank Select LSB*, CC 64 Sustain Pedal*, CC 120 All Sound Off*, CC 121 Reset All Controllers*, CC 123 All Notes Off*.
Left out, performance and channel mode controllers, which change no setting of the sound: CC 66 Sostenuto, CC 122 Local Control.

coverage.inboundControllers: the instrument sends these same controllers when its MIDI settings allow
